verdict.rationale: Connect documents splitting a charge between the platform and sellers, which lets the platform keep a cut of each transaction. It also offers no-code platform pricing tools for a range of pricing strategies. However, the evidence never explicitly describes application fees or markups, per-seller pricing assignment, or any report separating platform payments revenue from processing costs. Missing for 10: explicit application-fee/markup documentation, per-seller pricing configuration, revenue-vs-processing-cost reporting, independent corroboration.
